1.e4 e5 2.f3 Nf6 3.Bc4.strategy: Aims the bishop at f7, the weak point beside the king, but without a knight on f3 the pressure is slight. White's set-up stays awkward: the f-pawn blocks the king's knight, and e4 depends on that pawn alone.

1.e4 e5 2.f3 Nf6 3.Nc3.strategy: Adds a second guard to e4 and develops a piece towards the centre, so the knight on f6 has less to aim at. The set-up stays clumsy all the same: the pawn on f3 takes the best square from the king's knight and leaves the king's diagonal open.
1.e4 e5 2.f3 Nf6 3.Nc3.name: King's Pawn Game: King's Head Opening
